name: @pryzm/plugin-balcony
description: PRYZM — Balcony COMPOUND plugin (L-5600 / C103 / ADR-0333). A balcony is a COMPOUND, not a primitive: balcony.create composes a cantilever SLAB + its FLOOR FINISH + N RAILING runs along the free perimeter, in ONE undo entry via produceMultiStoreCommand. balcony.updateProfile re-derives all three from a new outline — the founder's 'edit the profile and the finish and railings adapt'. balcony.delete removes all of it. Geometry math lives in @pryzm/geometry-balcony (pure).
